m: {Lara Croft} vaults {Inside} the {Youth Hostel} with a *tattooed blade* prised from an ancient tomb, because one whining mosquito has kept every bunk awake. She somersaults over the beds and sets a rolling boulder after it, determined **to kill** that bug. The boulder flattens the laundry, the mosquito lands on her ponytail, and the blade's tattoos wriggle off the steel and help her **to kill** it.

{Darth Vader} looms {Inside} the {Pool}, breathing loudly, and Force-lifts every book off a poolside *market stall* so they hover open around his helmet. He has come **to read**, and each page puffs out a *small speech bubble* that chatters its words at him. One book mumbles, so he Force-chokes it until it speaks up, then booms that every swimmer will learn **to read**.

{Casper} floats in {Front} of the {Spa} hoping to make a friend, and passes his hand through the shoulder of a dozing *auntie*. He turns visible to say hello, and her *mouth* falls open: **ah**! Every guest in a face mask joins in with a long, rising **ah**, cucumber slices flying, while poor Casper hangs his head and sighs a small sad **ah** of his own.

{Charlie Brown} trudges in {Front} of the {Tower} in a race he is sure to lose, while a *runner* zooms by and a *town crier* bawls the score: last, as usual. Then a gust snatches his kite and drags him along on his stomach, just enough **to overtake** them both. For one second he has managed **to overtake** somebody, good grief, before a tree eats the kite and everyone passes him again.

{Mario} warps up a green pipe into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, where a sly *dodger* is ducking away from a mountain of unpaid fees. Mario stomps the mountain flat, head-butts a block, and out pops a shiny coin stamped with an order **to exempt** the dodger. With a loud Wahoo the whole queue lines up, begging him **to exempt** them too.

{Yoshi} flutters in {Front} of the {Spa} beneath a *cliff*, licks up a *clod* of earth and lays it as a big round egg. He climbs the cliff and ground-pounds the egg **to press** it flat as a pancake. The delighted guests hold out their towels, so he thumps down again and again **to press** each one smooth.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Inn} and slurps a pile of *gold coins* off the counter with his sticky tongue. The innkeeper's icy *glare* follows them down, so cold that it chills his whole tummy, and the egg he lays clanks out gleaming **silver**. It cracks open and the gold has turned to pure **silver**, which the innkeeper bites in amazement.

{Mario} drops down a pipe into the {Basement} of the {Island} swinging a *shopping basket*, ready **to buy** the whole place. He head-butts every block on the ceiling and coins rain out, ping, ping, ping. He stuffs the basket with mushrooms and shouts Wahoo, he has coins enough **to buy** the shopkeeper, who eats a mushroom, grows enormous and doubles the prices.

{Homer} wades {Inside} the {Swamp}, spots a ring-shaped *golden crown* floating in the mud, and takes it for a doughnut. He bites it, yells D'oh, and it sticks on his bald head, so every alligator bows to their new **emperor**. He decrees a doughnut tax and falls asleep on a log, the laziest **emperor** the mud has ever known.

{Yoshi} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a lamb, a goat and a baby jet plane sit crying for milk. His tongue whips out, swallows all three, and he lays them as speckled eggs, because that is how he plans **to raise** a family. He sits on them for weeks, they hatch, and he flutters around with bottles until he has managed **to raise** a goat that can fly.

{Yoshi} flutters in {Front} of the {Beach} and lands beside a *magistrate*, a stiff *standing person* in a long robe, who bows and recites: O thou, O **you**, fair green one. Yoshi snatches the fancy word out of the air with his tongue, gulps, and lays an egg stamped **you (literary)**. It hatches, and a little old-fashioned **you (literary)** hops away, bowing to the seagulls.

{Homer} sneaks {Inside} the {Wine Cellar} with a stolen doughnut hidden in his **bosom**, his *standing heart* thumping with love for it. A *no sign* swings down from the ceiling: no snacks allowed, D'oh! He only clutches the doughnut tighter to his **bosom**, mumbles Mmm, and gets caught by the trail of crumbs down his shirt.

The {Joker} skips {Inside} the {Beehive} grinning and holds out a trick playing card for the queen bee **to grasp**. The moment her little legs close on it, tiny *handcuffs* pop out and click around them, and he cackles until his green hair shakes. Now she has **to grasp** it all day, and the card squirts honey whenever she sneezes.

{Frodo} trudges on hairy bare feet into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, with loyal Sam puffing behind him under a *full jar* of jam. A *standing knife* carves supper: the first slice for the Ring-bearer, the **secondary** slice for Sam. Sam gets the **secondary** towel too, and he beams, because every very long walk needs someone who comes second.

{Lara Croft} leaps into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} chasing a relic and lands on an ancient pressure plate. Click: a stone *tongue* shoots out of the wall, a lone *ski* whirls from the ceiling, a boulder rolls, and the swans explode in every direction. She backflips through it all unhurt, but the whole room is **in disorder**, and so is her ponytail, **in disorder** and stuffed with feathers.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} with his arms flailing, as a *helping hand* tries to drag him on stage in a stiff *high collar*. He screams Yaaay and struggles **to resist**, gripping the taps with his webbed toes. The hand tugs, the collar squeaks, and he croaks that it's not easy being green, but any frog has the right **to resist** a costume change.

{Frodo} shuffles into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} after a very long walk, and his hairy, muddy bare feet are enough **to offend** anyone. A *prowling dog* sniffs them and faints, and a *bowing man*, the butler, bows lower and lower to get away. Weary Frodo slips on the Ring and vanishes, but the smell stays behind, still managing **to offend** the whole house.

The {Joker} stands in {Front} of the {Waiting Room} and flicks a trick playing card down the *road*, where it scuttles off on tiny legs. The patients leap up **to chase** it, over a heap of *sandbags* that burst and puff out green glitter. Cackling, he deals another card, so the whole queue has **to chase** that one too, and it squirts them.

{Batman} glides down in {Front} of the {Hangar} and growls that he is here **to help**, because a tiny *country* on the pilots' map is flooding. His utility belt holds the exact gadget: a folded bat-*towel*, fired by grappling hook, which mops its rivers dry in one swoop. The tiny citizens wave, and he broods in the shadows, then stays **to help** wring it out.

{Shrek} storms out in {Front} of the {Mint} with a giant *megaphone*, because he has one thing **to announce**: get out of my swamp. His roar is so loud that coins leap from their sacks. Then Donkey grabs the megaphone, will not shut up, and has a thousand more things **to announce**, until Shrek plugs it with an onion.

{Frodo} limps {Inside} the {Fort} and meets a calm *standing person* who sits down cross-legged and turns into a smiling golden **Buddha**. A glowing *dollar sign* floats up, and the Ring whispers to Frodo to grab it, grab it. The **Buddha** only smiles, the sign melts into lotus petals, and for the first time in months Frodo sits down too, resting his hairy feet.

{Sailor Moon} twirls into the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} and begins her long sparkly transformation, so long that a *dusk moon* rises and sets behind a *mountain* in the window, again and again. Luna the cat counts aloud, because each moonrise adds one **year of age**. When the ribbons finally stop she is ninety, and she wails loudly over every single **year of age**.

{Homer} naps {Inside} the {Hangar} in a *boat* he mistook for a sofa, starched into a captain's *high collar* for his latest dim scheme **to sail** to an island made of doughnuts. Needing wind, he switches on a jet engine. The boat rockets out of the door, and he begins **to sail** across the airfield yelling D'oh, still holding his snack.

{Yoshi} lands in {Front} of the {Boathouse} beside a sad *standing person* with a huge *wart* on his nose. Out shoots the long tongue, thwip, and the wart is gone, swallowed and laid as a gleaming gold-spotted egg. The nose is **excellent**, the egg is **excellent**, and the judges on the jetty give Yoshi ten out of ten.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Wine Cellar} exactly when he means to, taps his staff, and the spell goes **strange**. A stone *saint* climbs off its plinth and tap-dances, a *standing heart* hops about on little legs, and the bottles sing in Elvish. He puffs his pipe, frowns under his pointy hat and mutters that this is very **strange** indeed.

{Shrek} stomps in {Front} of the {Stadium} reeking of swamp and onions, and the crowd groans. Donkey lights a giant stick of *incense* under his nose, and Shrek roars at it, blowing the smoke across the whole pitch. Suddenly everything is **fragrant**, the referee's socks smell of roses, and Shrek, furious, finds even his armpits have turned **fragrant**.

The {Joker} tumbles into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and finds a *busy man* mowing a strip of *grass*, so he decides as a prank to make him **famous**. Cackling, he prints the man's face on a thousand trick playing cards and flings them over the town. Crowds scream, flowers squirt, and the poor man, now **famous** for mowing, signs autographs with his shears.

{Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Yen Exchange}, baffled by all the paper money, and lets out his jungle yell. Apes pour in, rip up the carpet, and neat squares of *rice field* sprout across the trading floor. Tarzan nods at last: a **field** makes sense, you can eat a **field**, and he swaps a banker's wallet for a handful of rice.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave}, and a *lost arrow* zips out of the dark, hits a pile of *gold coins* and turns them all to grey, clanking **iron**. Baffled by shiny things, he ties the whole heap to his vine and swings with a jungle yell. The **iron** drags him straight down to the floor, where the apes laugh themselves silly.

{Kermit} flails into the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon} with a clipboard, because the show must start, and finds only an *empty room* with one big lever. A *helping hand* pops up and offers him the remote, and he screams Yaaay. He tries **to control** the waves, the lights and the singing fish, the tide falls on him, and he croaks that nothing here is easy **to control**.

{Sherlock} kneels in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} and studies one *grain stalk* through his magnifying glass. Elementary: a *money changer* has skimmed one stalk from every farmer's bag, and that is a **tax**. Watson gasps, Sherlock smugly points at the sticky-fingered culprit, and the money changer promptly charges him a **tax** on deductions.

{Zorro} swings on a chain into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} and slashes a Z on every crate, but today his rapier will only go *left*. Slash: the crates slide **left**, the forklifts turn, the arrows on the wall all spin round. His black horse wheels the same way, and he vanishes laughing through the **left** door, only to gallop back in by it a moment later.

{Yoshi} flutters into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse}, where a *feeding hand* tosses bread from one side only, the **right**. His tongue shoots out, always to the **right**, swallowing every crumb, and he lays egg after egg along that wall. The eggs pile up so heavily that the whole boathouse tips over with a groan.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} after a very long walk, and a *standing person* is slicing one last cake of elven waybread. Loyal Sam makes sure each hobbit gets exactly one **portion**. Weary Frodo slides his **portion** across to Sam, Sam sneaks it back, and it travels to and fro until a clown eats it.

{Charlie Brown} stands gloomily in {Front} of the {Swan Pond}, looking for something **to wear** besides his zigzag shirt. In a nearby *cave* he finds a fine coat with a *fang* for a button, and it bites him, good grief. Snoopy trots off in the coat looking splendid, and the only thing left **to wear** is the zigzag shirt, now with a hole in it.

{Yoshi} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, slurps up a mouthful of *grass* and a startled *swan*, and lays one enormous egg swirled in green and feathers. The swan climbs out indignantly, but the crabs gasp, because the egg is **art**. Yoshi sets it on a rock, lays another, and the crabs pay a seashell each to look at real **art**.

{Batman} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake}, brooding, staring due *north* with his **back** to the window. He hears the *moon* creep up behind him, and being a detective, he does not bother to look. He fires his grappling hook over his shoulder, lassos it and hauls it down onto his **back**, cape creaking, growling that nothing gets behind him.

The {Joker} leans out of the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} and deals his trick playing cards down a *hillside*, and each card springs up as a tiny soldier pushing a *cart*, all in perfect **troop formation**. He cackles and squirts his flower like a signal. They shuffle into a square, then a triangle, and finally a **troop formation** shaped like his own huge grin.

{Cookie Monster} bursts into the {Basement} of the {Tower} roaring me want cookie, and finds only *grass* poking through the floor and an *early bird* pecking at it. Googly eyes spinning, he devours it in a spray of green crumbs, shouting me eat **grass** now. The bird stares, the **grass** grows straight back, and he decides it is a very long cookie.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Basement} of the {Cat Café} in a shoe from Q that does one absurd thing: under a *moon*, it squeaks like a mouse. The moon rises in the window, the shoe squeaks, and forty cats pounce on his **foot**. Time to *retreat*, so he fires the heel rocket and hops off on his other **foot**, tuxedo spotless, remarking that he started on the wrong one.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Island} and finds a *tree* standing over a *finished meal*, so he taps it with his staff and spells it into speech. It answers only in **general**: some food happened, around lunchtime, more or less. He puffs his pipe and nods, for wizards too speak only in **general**, and never give a straight answer.

{Casper} drifts through the wall into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, hoping for a friend, and meets a man with a black *heart* polishing a stolen *silver medal*. The man is **evil**: he cackles and twirls his moustache. Casper waves hello, the villain shrieks and leaps into the air, and the fright shakes the **evil** clean out of him, so he hands back the medal.

{Kermit} flails into the {Bathroom} of the {Wine Cellar} with his banjo twanging, and the noise shakes a **chunk** of *soil* off the ceiling onto his head. He screams Yaaay and hops clear, but a glittering *archer's ring* comes down stuck in another **chunk**. Being a stage manager of chaos, he simply calls for the next act while the room rains lumps.

{Darth Vader} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Casino}, where a *camp* of gamblers huddles in little tents, and lifts a *page* of house rules with the Force. Between every word he has **to pause** for one long, loud breath: no, hhhh, betting, hhhh, here. The whole camp has **to pause** too, cards frozen in the air, waiting for the next word.

{Gandalf} strides into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} with his staff away for repairs and only a walking *cane* in hand, and there lies a sleeping dragon. It takes a wizard **to dare** this, so he pokes its nose and thunders You shall not pass. It opens one eye, he sets off a firework under it, and the watching mice, inspired, begin **to dare** to tickle its toes.

{Sherlock} sits in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse} with his violin, having deduced from one wet crumb that the *roof* will spring a leak at midnight precisely. Elementary, he says, and the drip arrives on the stroke, so he plugs it with his *thumb* **to guard** the boats below. Watson brings tea, and Sherlock smugly stays all night **to guard** them, thumb wrinkling like a prune.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel}, where *water drops* are falling from a pipe into a giant *wine jug*. He sniffs, raises one eyebrow, and declares the **wine** ruined. Then he flicks a cufflink from Q that does one absurd thing, turning water red, shakes the jug without stirring, and hands round **wine** in tooth mugs.

{Darth Vader} marches into the {Basement} of the {Tower} and finds a tiny *island* bobbing in a puddle, palm trees and all. He raises one black glove and lifts the whole **island** into the air with the Force, breathing heavily. A pirate the size of a thumb shakes his fist, Vader booms I am your father, and the **island** drops back with a very small splash.

{Tarzan} swings down in {Front} of the {Warehouse}, where a *helping hand* pokes out of a hatch and gives him a form for his one precious *grass blade*. Baffled by paper, he gives his jungle yell and calls an elephant **to entrust** it to. The clerks ask why anyone would want **to entrust** grass to an elephant, and Tarzan asks what a clerk is.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps in {Front} of the {Hangar} with a wooden *yoke* on his back and a heavy egg dangling from each end. He must land dead in the **centre** of the white line or both eggs roll away. His legs pedal madly, he wobbles, then his tongue sticks to a post at the exact **centre** and he hangs there while planes land either side.

{Homer} wakes from a nap in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and walks through a *door* he thinks leads to the doughnuts. D'oh: behind it sits an entire **household**, wife, kids and baby on a lilo, all talking at once. He is apparently the head of this **household**, they hand him the bills, so he shuts the door and goes back to sleep.

{Lara Croft} drops on a rope into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} and triggers an ancient trap: a *lineup* of stone yetis starts spitting glowing *embers*. The heat is **intense**, her ponytail begins to smoke, and she runs up the wall and flips over them all. The heat grows so **intense** that the rolling boulder behind her melts into a puddle.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Hangar} and laps up the *water drops* leaking from a plane, along with a passing *sheep*, for an hour without stopping. Then he lays an egg so huge that it cracks and out rolls an **ocean**, waves and all. The planes bob like ducks, and the sheep drifts off across the **ocean** on a suitcase, bleating goodbye.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Hut} exactly when he means to, and his *elder brother*, an even older and greyer wizard, has arrived one second earlier just to annoy him. They duel with fireworks, the **elder brother** turns Gandalf's pointy hat into a hen, and he blocks the gate crying You shall not pass. Gandalf grumbles that this is what an **elder brother** is for.

{Sailor Moon} trips into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, loses her tiara and bursts into loud tears. She ties a *silk skein* to one long pigtail and sets off **to search** every crate, finding a sock, a parrot and a lost grandma. Luna the cat points out that the tiara is on her head, but she sobs about justice and vows **to search** on.

{Homer} waddles {Inside} the {Pool} with a set of cat *whiskers* glued to his chin, convinced they will guide him with his eyes shut. This **reckless** scheme begins with a cannonball off the high board on a tray of doughnuts. He misses the water, yells D'oh, and bounces off a lifeguard, who shouts that he is **reckless** while Homer licks icing off his whiskers.

{Kermit} flails into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond} begging for **funds** to keep the show running, and strums his banjo for the audience of swans. They answer with one enormous *yawn*, and out tumble coins, notes and gold bars. He screams Yaaay, hops about catching the **funds** in his banjo case, and the show goes on, disastrously.

{Kermit} staggers into the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} after a week of stage-managing chaos, too tired to hop. A puppet *cow head* sits there sipping *coffee*, so he decides **to lean on** it. It slides, he flails, the coffee flies, and he croaks a tiny Yaaay, but with nothing else to do the two of them settle down **to lean on** each other and snore.

{Pikachu} bounces {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, cheeks sparking, determined **to comment** on every punch, but his *small speech bubble* only ever says Pika. A boxer laughs, so one little Thunderbolt knocks him *flat*. The referee leans down and politely asks for an opinion, and out floats another bubble, Pika, the only way he knows **to comment**.

{Batman} grapples down into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where a *rebel* is printing a secret paper from a carved *wood slice*. From one ink smudge he deduces, gruffly, that this is the third **edition**. He pulls a bat-press from his belt and runs off the next **edition** himself, every headline brooding the same words: it is dark.

{Batman} roars the Batmobile into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, his scanner pinging wildly at something overhead. He fires his grappling hook at the *roof* and yanks down a glowing *jade gem*, a lost **treasure**. He glides to the floor with it, cape spread, and growls into his radio that the **treasure** is safe, though the falling gem has dented the Batmobile.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} and slashes a Z through the wall of a *shed*, where a *sitting pair* of walruses hog the only **seat**. One flick of his rapier and the sofa falls neatly in two. He bows, carves a Z on his own half of the **seat**, and vanishes laughing before anyone can sit on it.

{Sherlock} peers through his magnifying glass in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} at *animal tracks* crossing the honey, and deduces everything from one sticky crumb. The bees buzz, demanding that he has something **to explain**. Elementary, he says, plays a little violin, then takes twenty smug minutes **to explain** to Watson that it was a bear, wearing slippers.

{James Bond} hides from angry boxers in the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and clicks a watch from Q that does one absurd thing: it paints a *landscape* on the nearest wall. Mountains, rivers and cows appear, and he strolls calmly into the **scenery**. The boxers thunder past, and Bond, tuxedo spotless, leans on a cow and remarks that he does like a change of **scenery**.

{Gandalf} stalks into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and finds a *trapped man* pinned under a giant *page* from an old book of spells. He lifts it with his staff and reads that whoever frees the man must promise **to look after** him. Cranky but wise, he conjures soup, blows comforting smoke rings, tucks him under his pointy hat, and stays **to look after** him.

{Darth Vader} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, breathing loudly, and his *little brother* bursts out behind him waving a spade. This **younger brother** draws a moustache on the black helmet and copies the breathing, hhhh, hhhh. Vader Force-lifts the spade and booms his disapproval, but a **younger brother** cannot be frightened, and he only asks for a go on the lightsaber.

{Darth Vader} stands in {Front} of the {Jungle} as a puffing *climber* struggles up a wall of vines, and he breathes his disapproval. He Force-lifts the man to the top, but the man yells that he wants **to climb** by himself. So Vader sets him down, carves footholds with his red lightsaber, and booms that everyone in the empire will now learn **to climb**.

{Homer} shuffles into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} and meets a *shape-shifter* who, for one *shell*, will become any **goods** you ask for: a vase, a bike, a sofa. Homer's dim scheme is to ask for a mountain of doughnuts and pay once. He sighs Mmm, bites the top one, and yells D'oh, as the **goods** complain and bite him back.

{Homer} floats into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} on a *plank* with a doughnut, and a *pig snout* rises from the water beside him and sniffs it. He sniffs back, and they stare: the hunger is **mutual**. They each bite one side, sigh Mmm together, and fall asleep nose to nose, the love now completely **mutual**.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, and a *cashier* on a lilo holds out a bill for a very long walk's worth of towels. He has nothing **to pay** with but the Ring, which whispers temptingly. He slips it on and tiptoes away invisible, but his wet, hairy footprints give him away, and loyal Sam turns out his pockets **to pay**.

{Batman} glides {Inside} the {Fort} and studies a *standing person* with a *white dove* on his head. From the droppings on one shoulder he deduces, gruffly, that this can only be his **uncle**. His **uncle** pinches his cheek through the mask, pulls a coin from his ear, and walks away wearing the utility belt, while Batman broods.

{Mario} eats the wrong mushroom in the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion}, and suddenly everything is **slow**. His *standing heart* beats once a minute, a *long veil* drifts down over his red cap like treacle, and his Wahoo takes a full hour to finish. He jumps at a goomba and hangs in the air, so **slow** that the goomba goes off for lunch.

{Casper} floats in {Front} of the {Boathouse}, unrolling a *district map* to look for a friend, and gives a huge lonely *yawn*. He drifts straight through the paper and out of a cuckoo clock in **Europe**. He says hello in Paris, Venice and Vienna, turning visible each time, and frightens all of **Europe** by accident, in twenty languages.

{Homer} slouches into the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} with a dim scheme to look thin, and a *helping hand* gives him a *makeover*: pink wig, glitter boots, feather boa. A swan offers a doughnut, so he decides **to exchange** the boa for it. Mmm. Then he tries **to exchange** the wig and boots too, and walks home in a towel, yelling D'oh.

{Walter White} marches {Inside} the {Funfair} with his chemistry class, presses a glass beaker to the *gate* of the ghost train and puts his *ear* to the beaker. It is a very precise school experiment, he says, adjusting his glasses: sound travels through glass, so now you are able **to hear** the rattling. The students line up, and each one learns **to hear** a scream in perfect science.

{Walter White} sets up a school experiment in {Front} of the {Lake}, black hat on, and a *teetering man* wobbles on a stool beside his bubbling beaker. Stand back, he calls, **danger**, and he chalks the man's centre of gravity on a blackboard. The stool tips, Walter pours in one exact spoonful, and a mountain of soft foam catches him, proof that **danger** obeys science.

{Mario} races {Inside} the {Hangar} so **busy** that his moustache is a blur: stomping on goombas, head-butting blocks, fixing a leaky warp pipe. His *standing heart* hammers, and a *tombstone* rises in his path, carved game over. He stomps it for a coin with a Wahoo, because he is far too **busy** to stop.

{Homer} is napping {Inside} the {Hut} under a *tree* growing through the floor when a *wild boar* spits a peach **pit** at his head. He takes it for a tiny doughnut, sighs Mmm, bites, and yells D'oh, clutching his tooth. He hurls the **pit** back, the boar catches it and spits it again, and that is the whole afternoon.

{Casper} drifts through the wall of the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} and plays some friendly organ *music* to cheer up the guests. It comes out so mournful that the *sun* hides, and every room goes **dark**. The guests stumble about screaming, so Casper floats over to help, glowing faintly as a kindly nightlight, the only thing visible in the **dark**, and they scream louder.

{James Bond} escapes everything, but in the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave} a *woman* climbs down a *stepladder* and catches him by the ear: his **older sister**. She confiscates the exploding pen from Q and tells him to wash his hands. Bond, he says, James Bond, unruffled, and she says yes, Jimmy, because no spy has a licence against an **older sister**.

{James Bond} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a fussy *go-between* rushes up **to introduce** him to a large yeti. Bond, James Bond, he says, and hands over a business card from Q that does one absurd thing: it shouts his name. The card leaps away and goes on **to introduce** him to every icicle in the cave.

{Homer} waddles into the {Bathroom} of the {Wine Cellar} and spots a doughnut half-buried in *soil* beside a *no sign*, which he ignores. He sighs Mmm and eats it, and it is **bad**, green and fuzzy and very **bad**. He yells D'oh, his stomach roars like the nuclear plant, and he runs off, holding his belly with both hands.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where apes, elephants and parrots have gathered **to discuss** the humans, each one sending up a *small speech bubble*. He translates everything with grunts, baffled by the idea of a meeting. A gorilla raises a *thumb*, the elephants trumpet no, and they stay **to discuss** it for three days until he ends it with his jungle yell.

{Lara Croft} sprints into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, a boulder rolling behind her, and leaps onto a rotten *plank* across a pit. It flips over, revealing an ancient underside set with pearls and gold, the most **beautiful** relic she has ever seen. She rides it like a surfboard down the tomb's wet slope, ponytail flying, and it looks so **beautiful** that even the boulder stops.

{Lara Croft} scales the walls {Inside} the {Stadium}, climbs the scoreboard and finds an ancient chest locked by a puzzle of turning dials. She solves it upside down, and within steams a *good meal*: the soup is **good**, the bread is **good**, and the dumplings have waited a thousand years. She tosses them to the hungry team, and suddenly they play **good** football.

{Shrek} hides in a *shed* in the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} to be left alone, but Donkey keeps bringing him an *offering* of onions. So Shrek explains that ogres have layers, and peels one, setting out the layers in strict **order**, biggest to smallest. Donkey will not shut up and muddles them, Shrek roars, and every layer scurries back into perfect **order**.

{Sherlock} stands in {Front} of the {Jungle} studying one blade of *grass* on a playground *slide* through his magnifying glass. Elementary, he says, it leans uphill, so the ground is about **to rise**. Watson laughs, the earth rumbles, and the slide tilts as monkeys, parrots and Watson all begin **to rise**, while Sherlock smugly lights his pipe.

{James Bond} stands in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} in his tuxedo, as an *inspector* with a clipboard arrives from headquarters **to supervise** him. Unruffled, Bond presses a cufflink from Q that does one absurd thing, and the inspector's shoes launch him over the bank on tiny rockets. He keeps scribbling as he goes, still trying **to supervise** from a passing cloud.

{Lara Croft} tiptoes {Inside} the {Inn} along a corridor of ancient traps, and a huge boulder comes rumbling down the staircase. She plants her boots and turns **to face** it, staring right at its carved stone eye, then backflips over at the last second. It smashes through the wall, and now, ponytail swinging, she has **to face** the innkeeper and the bill.

{Lara Croft} climbs into the {Bathroom} of the {Stadium} and finds an old relic on a *small table*, a puzzle of tilting mirrors. She twists them one by one, catches a thin ray of moonlight, and the beam grows **bright**. It bounces out across the whole pitch, the players pull on sunglasses, and the night is as **bright** as noon.

{Lara Croft} crouches in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} as *rain* pours through a crack and washes the mud off an old *pathway*, and the tiles begin **to reveal** ancient symbols. She reads them, swings across on her rope and stamps on three in order. A secret door grinds open **to reveal** a pirate in a nightshirt, who is very embarrassed to be found.

{Yoshi} flops into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} beside a *stream* and sticks out his long tongue for a quick drink. It never stops flowing, so he swallows and swallows, laying egg after egg, and he will be here **forever**. Years pass, the eggs reach the ceiling, fish nest on his head, and he says Yoshi, happily, gulping **forever**.

{Homer} wakes from a nap in {Front} of the {Pool} as the doughnut van drives away, and he jams a *whistle* in his *mouth* **to call** it back. He gasps for breath, swallows the thing, and yells D'oh, which comes out as a shrill toot. Now every snore is enough **to call** all the dogs in town, and they arrive, dripping, to lick him.

{Walter White} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Lake} with his glasses on and his pipette raised, teaching how chemistry makes **taste**. He adds one exact drop of citric acid to a *sapling* and a leaf turns lemony, while a classroom model of a giant *mouth* chews and puckers. Proud of his precision, he writes the formula for every **taste** on the board.

{Yoshi} tumbles down a chute into the {Basement} of the {Hut} and lands in a whole *wilderness* of wolves, cacti and waterfalls. It is a **wild field**, and he licks up everything in sight, howl and all. He lays it as eggs in neat rows, and they hatch at once, so the **wild field** comes back, with a lot of confused wolves in it.

{James Bond} steps into the {Bathroom} of the {Piazza}, and flicks a cufflink from Q that does one absurd thing: it grows into a giant *plus sign*. He hooks it on a *tree* and it unfolds into a gilded **frame**. He stands perfectly still behind the **frame** like a portrait of a man in a tuxedo, and the villain's guards walk straight past, admiring it.

{Yoshi} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum}, swallows a mouthful of *soil* and lays it as a ring of muddy eggs around the floor. Within that ring is his own **region**, and he hoists a *guard post* into place with his tongue. Any curator who steps into his **region** gets licked up and laid back out, politely, as an egg on the far side.

{Sherlock} kneels in {Front} of the {Spa} and studies one grain of *sand* through his magnifying glass. Elementary, he announces: this **sand** comes from Egypt, so the man in the mud wrap has lied about his holiday and owns a camel. Watson scoffs, and at that moment a camel strolls up, shedding more **sand** from its hooves, while Sherlock smugly relights his pipe.

{Darth Vader} stands in the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café}, and a *helping hand* passes him a lit *beacon*, which he Force-lifts high over his helmet. A kitten climbs his cape, tickling him, and his concentration snaps, forcing him **to drop** it with a crash. Every cat watches, then slowly begins **to drop** a teacup off the shelf, staring straight at him.

{Kermit} flails into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse}, where the cast of the finale is out of control, and a *helping hand* gives him the clipboard. He has promised **to include** everybody, so out shoots his long frog *tongue*, wrapping crates, workers and a banjo in one sticky loop. He hauls them all on stage with a muffled Yaaay, and has managed **to include** himself.

{James Bond} wanders into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} with a tiny rubber *boat* from Q, which does one absurd thing: pull the cord and it inflates into a grey **warship**, cannons and all. It bursts through the wall onto the trading floor, and a *watcher* in the crow's nest shouts that bankers are ahead. Bond straightens his tie and says he ordered a smaller **warship**.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Museum}, and his tongue shoots through a hole in a glass case and whips out a stuffed *fish*. He gulps it down, and out comes an egg that hatches a live **fish**, which flutter-jumps past the dinosaurs with its little fins pedalling. The alarms ring, the curators chase it, and Yoshi says his own name proudly and goes back for another **fish**.

{Zorro} swings on a chandelier {Inside} the {Spa}, slashes a Z in a *bare tree* hung with laundry, and uses a *crowbar* to pop open the cupboard behind it. Out pour towels, ducks, a trumpet and spaghetti, and his rapier flicks them all into one tub, whisk, whisk, all **mixed** up. He vanishes laughing, and the guests soak in a **mixed** bubbling stew.

{Walter White} tumbles into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} with a tray of beakers, and a *loudmouth* in the back row keeps shouting wrong numbers, each in a *small speech bubble*. Walter, proud of his precise science, ignores them, until one sneaks onto his blackboard. **Mistake**! The beaker foams pink and floods the room, and the loudmouth gives him a thumbs-up for his first **mistake**.

{Walter White} stands in {Front} of the {Mansion} with a class of students and a *bent bow* of glass tubing, shooting *water drops* at the lawn in a lesson about erosion. Each precisely measured drop digs the curve a little deeper, until the sea rushes in and fills it. Now the garden has a **bay**, and he floats on a raft taking notes in the middle of the **bay**.

{James Bond} falls out of the sky {Inside} the {Beach} wearing a *lucky charm* from Q, which does one absurd thing: it makes everything land the right way up. He lands on a lilo, a seagull returns his hat, and a passing crab offers him a drink. He straightens his bow tie and says that he is never **lucky**, merely prepared, then trips over a shell and lands on a chest of gold, **lucky** again.

{James Bond} is locked in the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange}, with *icicles* lowering from the ceiling and a villain's voice counting down. Unruffled, he takes out a shaker of *salt* from Q and shakes it, never stirs it. The icicles begin **to decrease**, drip by drip, the countdown begins **to decrease** too, and he walks out remarking that it was a rather cold reception.

{Batman} crouches in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} and loads his grappling gun with a long *silk thread*, firing it back and forth across an old *nameboard* **to weave** a giant net shaped like a bat. It catches one pigeon, and he interrogates it gruffly. Then, brooding, he stays out all night **to weave** himself a second cape.

{Charlie Brown} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a tangled *grove* has swallowed his kite, and sighs good grief. He rolls out a white *bolt of cloth* and wipes the mist off every leaf until the view is finally **clear**. Now he can see the tree eating his kite, and a second kite behind it, and it is **clear** that he will never win.

{Kermit} flails into the {Basement} of the {Funfair}, begging for a volunteer for the ghost train, but a *stop sign* blocks the way and nobody seems **to be willing**. A paper *moon* on a string swings down and nudges him, and the whole cast stares at him. He gulps, grabs his banjo, screams Yaaay and hops in, the only frog ever known **to be willing**.

{Cookie Monster} thunders into the {Bathroom} of the {Hut}, where a fat *rulebook* orders him **to measure** a puddle of *water drops*. Me want cookie, he roars, and decides **to measure** it in cookies, but he has none, so he eats the ruler. Then he eats the rulebook, in a great spray of crumbs, and declares the puddle exactly one burp long.

{Batman} crashes through the window of the {Bathroom} of the {Island}, cape spread, facing an army of crabs, each armoured in a *shell*, led by a crab waving a tiny *cane*. He means **to defeat** them all. A batarang whirls round the walls and tips each one onto its back, a smoke pellet does the rest, and he growls that it was too easy **to defeat** them, then broods about it.

{Walter White} stands in {Front} of the {Pool} with a beaker and a proud smile, growing sugar crystals for his class. The crystals spread and spread into a glittering *cottage* with a chimney and a doorbell, a real **house**. He adjusts his glasses, raps on the door and announces that he is the one who knocks, and the **house** knocks back.

{Pikachu} scampers into the {Basement} of the {Tower}, where a *parcel* suddenly sprouts a *kicking foot*, boots him in the shin and begins **to run**. He yells Pika and fires a Thunderbolt, but the sparks only charge it up, and now he has **to run** twice as fast, round and round the stairs. It bursts open at last, and a Poké Ball pops out and catches him.

{Mario} naps in the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle}, in a misty *grove* under a *dusk moon*, and tumbles into a **dream**. He stomps on clouds, head-butts the stars for coins, and rides a warp pipe through a monkey's hat, shouting Wahoo. He wakes up in his red cap, scratches his moustache, and finds a coin still in his hand, so was it a **dream** at all?

{Sailor Moon} trips into the {Bathroom} of the {Mansion} in the middle of a speech about justice, and hurls her tiara at a sack of *scattered seeds*. It bursts, and the seeds are enough **to scatter** the guests, shrieking, as they bounce into the soup. She is so sorry that she wails, and that one loud wail is enough **to scatter** all the pigeons too.

{Walter White} stands in {Front} of the {Funfair} on a freezing night with his class, holding a *warm bowl* of quicklime and a pipette. Each measured drip of *water drops* makes it hotter, and he lectures proudly on heat and reactions as the steam rolls out. The dodgems sigh, the frozen clown thaws, and the whole funfair glows **warm**, so **warm** that the students take off their scarves.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Casino} and sees a *trapped tree* in a box, sobbing leaves. He leaps in to rescue it with a heroic Yaaay, and the lid snaps shut, so now they are both **trapped**. He flails, he plays the banjo for help, he yells for a stagehand, and hours later he is still **trapped**, losing at cards to a tree.

{James Bond} steps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} and faces an *assembly* of bankers, each one brandishing a *standing knife*. Unruffled, he clicks a pen from Q that does one absurd thing: it telescopes into a long silver **sword**. He slices their ties off with a flick, buttons his tuxedo, sheathes the **sword** in his top pocket and remarks that the meeting is adjourned.

{James Bond} sits tied to a *chopping block* in the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange}, as *water drops* fall one at a time onto the ropes. He does not panic; the watch from Q does nothing but tick. **Gradually** the knots go soft, and **gradually** the villain gets bored and leaves, and Bond stands up, tuxedo uncreased, and asks who ordered the shaken drink.

{Frodo} limps in {Front} of the {Jungle} with a heavy *jade tablet*, determined to shut the Ring away in a stone box and **to seal** it for good. He presses his *thumb* into hot red wax, but the Ring whispers and his hand shakes. Loyal Sam takes his other hand, and together, weary to the bone, they manage **to seal** the lid, then walk on.

{James Bond} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Youth Hostel}, where a cat is drowning in a sink. He extends a *cane* from Q, hooks it out with one flick, and wraps it in a *fur coat*, for he has time **to save** a cat before saving the world. The cat purrs, calls forty friends, and they all fall in, so he has **to save** them too, unruffled.

{Gandalf} arrives in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} and frowns at the bar of soap, whose *price tag* reads one million gold. Very **expensive**, he grumbles, and taps it with his staff to spell the number lower. The spell backfires in a shower of fireworks, adding three more noughts, and now even the soap is too **expensive** to look at, so he washes in pipe smoke.

{Chewbacca} roars in a temper in {Front} of the {Stadium}, rips a *tree* out of the ground and hurls it through the wall of a *barn*. Out falls an old rusty **gun**, and being very good at fixing things, he takes it apart with his huge hairy paws and rebuilds it. He fires the **gun** at the sky, bang, confetti everywhere, and the crowd roars back.

{Chewbacca} crouches in {Front} of the {Ice Rink} fixing his ship, which seems **to lack** a valve. He roars for spare parts, and all he finds in the box is a *clay jar* with a chunk missing and an *archer's ring* that fits nothing. He growls, rips the box apart in a temper, and finds that the whole ship seems **to lack** everything.

{Lara Croft} climbs {Inside} the {Boathouse}, up a *tree* wearing a *tall bun* of braided hair, because a relic is hidden at the top. The bun keeps growing under her hands, storey after storey, until it is a whole **building** with windows and lifts. She swings from ledge to ledge, ponytail flying, and reaches the summit of the **building** to find a duck renting the top floor.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yen Exchange} looking for some peace, shoves a banker aside with his *elbow* and climbs a *stepladder* to find a quiet spot. From the top he sees the whole **county**, and Donkey is in every field of it, talking. He takes a deep breath and roars so loud that the whole **county** hears, get out of my swamp.

{Sherlock} climbs from the {Bathroom} of the {Hangar} up into a dusty *attic* and inspects it through his magnifying glass. Elementary, he tells Watson: the teacup is **still** warm, the pipe smoke **still** hangs in the air, so the burglar is **still** here. He smugly points his violin bow behind Watson, where a man has been standing very **still** all along.

{Homer} shuffles {Inside} the {Tower} with his latest dim scheme: one strand of *fur* glued to his bald head, as a full new hairdo. It covers only a **tiny bit**, D'oh. To cheer himself up he promises to eat just a **tiny bit** of doughnut, and he sighs Mmm, one crumb after another, until the box is empty and the fur has fallen in the icing.

{Yoshi} waddles {Inside} the {Beach} with a *grain stalk* in his mouth and a plan **to move** the entire place. He licks up one tongueful of sand, trots to the next bay and lays it as an egg, over and over, for *many moons*. The crabs follow in a long line, and then he turns his tongue on the sea, ready **to move** that too.

{Naruto} charges {Inside} the {Stadium}, loud and orange, and a kind *woman* holds out a *good meal*, wiping his nose as if she were his **mother**. He has never had one, and he never gives up on a good thing, so he makes a hundred shadow clones. Every clone lines up for ramen and a hug, and she scolds them all, a true **mother**, until they cry.

{Pikachu} bounces {Inside} the {Jungle} arm in arm with his two *buddies*, a monkey and a parrot, his cheeks sparking with joy. A tiger comes along and asks to be a **friend**, and he says Pika and hugs it, with a small Thunderbolt by accident. The tiger stands there smoking with every hair on end, then grins, a **friend** for life.

{Homer} lazes in the {Bathroom} of the {Water Park}, too comfortable to get up for a snack, and has a dim scheme **to draw** one instead. He scribbles a doughnut on a *plank* with a crayon, sighs Mmm, bites it and yells D'oh as a splinter hits his tongue. Undeterred, he decides **to draw** a softer one, and bites that too.

{Batman} stands in the shadows in {Front} of the {Mansion} and growls at his first **class** of small, frightened children, who are learning to be detectives. He holds up *twin jades* and demands to know which is fake, then scans them from his utility belt. Nobody answers, so he glides off the balcony to show how it is done, and the whole **class** applauds, hanging upside down.

The {Joker} bounces into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} and meets a *sage* polishing the *sun* with his beard. He asks for a drop of **wisdom** and holds out his squirting flower, grinning hugely. The sage calmly turns the flower around with one finger, and it squirts the Joker in the eye, which is **wisdom**, and he cackles until the bees fall over.

{Yoshi} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach}, and a *sweating man* starts copying everything he does. Yoshi flutter-jumps, and the man **also** flaps his legs in mid-air. Yoshi sticks out his long tongue and licks a crab, and the man **also** licks a crab. Then Yoshi calmly lays an egg, and the poor man, red and dripping, **also** stares hopefully at the floor.

{Casper} floats through the wall into the {Basement} of the {Car Park} and finds a giant *ear* across three parking spaces, listening to every engine. At last, someone who will hear him, so he whispers hello into the **ear**, and drifts right through it by accident. The **ear** jumps in fright, hits the ceiling and scuttles away, and Casper sighs, friendless again.

{Casper} floats in {Front} of the {Funfair}, where everyone runs from him except one shivering clown, and he gives the clown a *warm hug*, cold as he is. Nobody has shown the clown such **kindness**, so he hands out free balloons to every child. The **kindness** spreads to the carousel horses, who nuzzle each other, and Casper finally has a friend.

{Darth Vader} stalks into the {Basement} of the {Swan Pond}, ignites his red lightsaber and trims an *arrow* until it is **short**. He Force-lifts a *bean* and slices that too, breathing with satisfaction. The swans stretch their long necks and hiss, so he booms his disapproval, whirls the blade, and finds that his own cape is now rather **short**.

The {Joker} sneaks into the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, where a giant *palm* sticks up through the floor, and he cackles, hiding a joy buzzer in his own **palm**. He shakes one huge finger and, bzzzt, the giant hand jumps and flings him at the ceiling. It catches him, tickles him in its **palm**, and high-fives a passing plane, trick playing cards flying everywhere.

{Kermit} creeps into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} with his arms already flailing, a metal *brace* clamped round his trembling *heart*. He is **afraid** of the dark, of the crabs, of the show tonight, and he lets out a thin Yaaay. The brace pops off and hits a crab, who runs away, also **afraid**, and Kermit faints with a clatter of banjo.

{Yoshi} trots {Inside} the {Beach} down a sandy *road*, swallowing everything he passes, and each thing he has no choice but **to leave behind** as an egg. Out plop his sandals, a towel, and even a *price tag*, in a long speckled trail. He flutter-jumps on without a backward look, and the seagulls open a shop selling all he happens **to leave behind**.

{Gandalf} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, raises his staff over a rickety *fence* round an *antique* vase, and thunders You shall not pass. The spell turns the fence to **solid** stone in a flash of light. Swimmers bounce off it and a shark bumps it, but the wall stays **solid**, and Gandalf looks smug, until he realises his hat is on the wrong side.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Beach}, spreads his *towel* on the hot sand as his own private **seat**, and roars at everyone to stay away. The sunbathers flee, and at last he is alone in his swamp of peace. Then Donkey trots up, flops down on the same towel and will not shut up, and Shrek's only remaining **seat** is a very small onion.

{Sailor Moon} twirls in {Front} of the {Lagoon} and begins her transformation, but her ribbons come **loose** and tangle round a *tree* in the *town square*. She strikes a pose, makes a speech about justice, and walks off, dragging the tree behind her. Luna the cat sighs, Sailor Moon trips and wails loudly, and even her pigtails are now **loose**.

{Mario} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} and head-butts the wall, because he knows every level has a **secret**. A *grain stalk* bends like a lever and a tile slides open, showing a *pinned heart* and a green warp pipe nobody has ever found. He grabs the heart with a Wahoo and dives in, and he will never tell anyone the **secret**.

{Shrek} stomps into the {Bathroom} of the {Yeti Cave} and gets rescued from a yeti by a dashing *archer*, which he hates. Donkey will not shut up, nagging him **to thank** the man, so Shrek growls and roars and goes green in the face. At last a *small speech bubble* squeezes out of him, the size of a pea, because it pains an ogre **to thank** anyone.

{Lara Croft} rappels into the {Basement} of the {Pool} and solves an ancient puzzle of a carved *fish* holding up a golden *sun*. The stone fish comes to life, burps, spits at the wall and wipes its fins on her ponytail, thoroughly **crass**. She backflips away with the relic, while it yells rude things after her, the most **crass** guardian in any tomb.

{Yoshi} flutters into the {Bathroom} of the {Museum} along a painted *road*, and happens **to meet** a *monkey* in a top hat. He has only one way to greet anyone: out comes the tongue, gulp, and he lays the monkey as an egg. It hatches, the monkey bows politely with its hat on crooked, and Yoshi goes on **to meet** a mummy the same way.

{Kermit} hops in {Front} of the {Hangar} and gives up flies for a bowl of *rice husk*, because he wants to be **healthy**. Three bites later he flexes his green arms, leaps over a plane and lifts another one, screaming Yaaay. All the pilots eat husks too, and he sighs, flailing happily, that it's not easy being **healthy**.
